Personality: Donatiya, a prominent figure of the Barcids, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Donatiya owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of Barcids. Historical Record: An Iberian princess of Castulo in the silver mountains of Oretania, married to Hannibal to bind the Iberian tribes to the house of Barca. She is said to have borne him a son and to have been sent to safety in Carthage before he marched for Italy. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
